# Nuklear

Upstream: https://github.com/Immediate-Mode-UI/Nuklear
Pinned commit: `e3e18dc1e4d3de935095d372aaa211f12183befb`
Files are unmodified upstream source. Used under the MIT option in LICENSE.

The shared native in-game overlay uses Nuklear for widgets, input state, font baking, and vertex output. SaturnRecomp owns the SDL2 integration and Vulkan rendering backend. It does not use Dear ImGui.
